  "phoneNote": "The hero card covers almost the entire background photo so only tree leaves are visible, and the bottom burgundy area repeats the address, directions link, phone number, and email twice in a row.",
  "desktopNote": "The editorial serif typography and wine-red palette suit a traditional Prlekija gostilna well, but the contact section and footer immediately below it duplicate the exact same address, directions link, and contact details.",

  },
  "fixes": [
    "Merge the reservation contact block and the footer so the address, 'Navodila za pot' link, phone number,email, and opening hours are not repeated back-to-back.",
    "On mobile, place the hero text card below the photo of the house and terrace instead of overlapping it, so visitors see the building rather than just blurry leaves.",
    "Replace the single 'Domov' link in the desktop header with useful anchor links (e.g. Ponudba, O nas, Kontakt) or a reservation call-to-action."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "On both phone and desktop, the bottom burgundy reservation block and the footer directly beneath it repeat the exact same address, 'Navodila za pot' link, phone number, and email."
  ]
}
